statement: Continue the arbitrary diagonal-minus-[omega] family of frontier-20261028-weighted-matching-decomposability-v1.json SHA256 27ba86554a53b9055f965f9077f568423f472cf596f7c98d54f3576c9075b73c. Normalize kappa=1. In its only unresolved topology, q_0i<1 for leaves i=1,2,3, q_ij>1 on the leaf triangle, and sum_leaf_pairs 1/q_ij<1. Set a_i=d_ii-1, b_i=1-q_0i in (0,1], bmax=max_i b_i. If bmax*b_1*b_2*b_3<=a_0^2, then every 2-block-positive W is decomposable. Therefore any indecomposable 2-block-positive member of the entire full-rank-correlated diagonal family must have the low-q star topology and strict reverse inequality bmax*b_1*b_2*b_3>a_0^2; in particular a_0<1, i.e. the normalized center diagonal coefficient d_00<2. No existence is claimed.
basic_rank_two_tests: The rank-two diagonal vector x|00>+y|ii> forces [[a_0,-1],[-1,a_i]]>=0, so a_0>0 and a_i>=1/a_0. For distinct leaves i,j, use a rank-one 2x2 coefficient block on i,j with diagonal x,y>=0 and a singleton coefficient z>=0 on the center. Minimizing the offdiagonal pair cost gives 2q_ij*x*y; minimizing z=(x+y)/a_0 gives (a_i-1/a_0)x^2+(a_j-1/a_0)y^2+2(q_ij-1-1/a_0)xy>=0. Hence q_ij>=1+1/a_0-sqrt((a_i-1/a_0)(a_j-1/a_0)).
explicit_schur_construction: Choose c_0i=q_0i, and for leaves choose c_ij=min(q_ij,1+b_i*b_j/a_0). For each q_e>0 let B_e=(c_e/q_e)*[[d_ij,-q_e],[-q_e,d_ji]] on span{|ij>,|ji>}; if q_e=0 set B_e=0. These blocks are PSD and c_e<=q_e, so A=W-B^Gamma has nonnegative diagonal on offdiagonal basis states. Its correlated 4x4 block has central diagonal a_0, leaf diagonals a_i, central-leaf entries -b_i, and leaf-leaf entries min(q_ij-1,b_i*b_j/a_0). Its Schur complement in the center is a 3x3 real symmetric matrix R with R_ii=r_i=a_i-b_i^2/a_0>=a_i-1/a_0>=0 and R_ij=-h_ij, where h_ij=max(0,1+b_i*b_j/a_0-q_ij).
entrywise_deficit_bound: The three-index rank-two bound implies h_ij<=sqrt((a_i-1/a_0)(a_j-1/a_0))<=sqrt(r_i*r_j): indeed, when h_ij>0, substituting the bound yields h_ij<=sqrt((a_i-1/a_0)(a_j-1/a_0))-(1-b_i*b_j)/a_0. Thus every 2x2 principal block of R is PSD.
at_most_one_deficit: If h_ij>0 then q_ij<1+b_i*b_j/a_0. If two distinct high-triangle edges ij and ik had h>0, then sum_leaf_pairs 1/q >= 1/(1+b_i*b_j/a_0)+1/(1+b_i*b_k/a_0). For u,v>=0, 1/(1+u)+1/(1+v)>=1 exactly when uv<=1. The assumed bmax*b_1*b_2*b_3<=a_0^2 implies b_i^2*b_j*b_k<=a_0^2 for each shared vertex i, so those two reciprocals would sum to at least 1, contradicting the strict predecessor condition. Hence at most one h_ij is nonzero. R is then a direct sum of a nonnegative singleton and one PSD 2x2 block, so R>=0; the Schur complement gives A>=0 and W=A+B^Gamma.
weighted_and_limits: For a full-Schmidt-rank negative ket psi=sum_i c_i|ii>, first apply the invertible diagonal congruence specified in the predecessor; a_i and q are measured after scaling that transformed W by kappa. The remaining strict inequalities are necessary only and may well be impossible; no candidate witness or PPT/SN3 state has been established. The graph/matching predecessor imports the known 3x3 theorem for disconnected low graphs. The new Schur/rank-two argument is all-variable WRITTEN reasoning, not formal or independent review and not a novelty claim.
